name: avatar
description: Displays an image or fallback for a person or entity.

<script module lang="ts">
import type { Avatar as ShardsAvatar } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

export type AvatarRootProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAvatar.Root>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

const baseClass =
  "inline-flex size-8 shrink-0 select-none items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-background align-middle font-medium text-xs";

let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: AvatarRootProps = $props();
const classes = $derived(cn(baseClass, className));
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Root bind:ref data-slot="avatar" class={classes} {...props} />

<script module lang="ts">
import type { Avatar as ShardsAvatar } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

export type AvatarImageProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAvatar.Image>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: AvatarImageProps = $props();
const classes = $derived(cn("size-full object-cover", className));
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Image bind:ref data-slot="avatar-image" class={classes} {...props} />

<script module lang="ts">
import type { Avatar as ShardsAvatar } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

export type AvatarFallbackProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAvatar.Fallback>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

const baseClass = "flex size-full items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted";

let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: AvatarFallbackProps = $props();
const classes = $derived(cn(baseClass, className));
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Fallback bind:ref data-slot="avatar-fallback" class={classes} {...props} />
